title: Looking for submissions for my curated AI Games collection
author: Skill-Additional
selftext:
Please let me know about worthy games or game collections to review and showcase.

[https://promptcade.com/game-showcase](https://promptcade.com/game-showcase)

replies.author: Skill-Additional
replies.body: How did you integrate AI into this? Is it a local model for the NPC?

comments.author: featherless_fiend
comments.body:
This one has a high review score for having AI art: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3411020/Villages__Dungeons/

I think that might be a good idea to do, construct a list of games on Steam that have reviewed very well but use AI, and then we can use this list as a weapon against antis who claim there are no good AI games.

replies.author: Skill-Additional
replies.body: Adding for now, I may need to add come community voting feature later. Thanks

replies.author: Skill-Additional
replies.body: Thanks added, I like the narration feature. Is that Eleven Labs?

replies.author: katsuthunder
replies.body: nice, ty for the link! no we're using kokoro tts on deepinfra

comments.author: PikachuDash
comments.body: It would be cool to see [Euphoria: AI Choices](https://euphoriastories.com/) featured in your collection. It's an AI story game with a similar UX/UI to choice games like Chapters and Episode, chapter system & advanced plot planning features and more. It's out on Android and iOS.

replies.author: Skill-Additional
replies.body: I will note it for now, I think maybe this will need it's own category. I am more focused on Arcade style games.

replies.author: Skill-Additional
replies.body: Thanks, what did you use to make this??

replies.author: argidev
replies.body: It's called Upit, the same website the games are hosted on. It's an AI enhanced game editor. I've already created 30 games for my portfolio, but I only shared one of the most played one

replies.author: Skill-Additional
replies.body: Oh cool I’d not heard of it. Thanks for sharing :)

replies.author: Skill-Additional
replies.body: I didn't quite get at first why I kept getting game over then I realized I had to line up my shots.
